purpose: Define one deterministic development-only feasibility/control test before inspecting candidate economics. This contract is not a promotion or prospective holdout gate.
horizon_aggregation: ALL_FROZEN_HORIZONS_MUST_PASS; Alpha-Proof P3 scalar metrics are the conservative worst-horizon summaries, never the best horizon.

p4_controls.direction_flip: same events and horizons, opposite direction; full-model gross expectancy must be strictly greater at every horizon
p4_controls.time_shift_placebo: same direction shifted +60m; full-model gross expectancy must be strictly greater at every horizon
p4_controls.delayed_entry: same direction shifted +15m; full-model gross expectancy must be strictly greater at every horizon
p4_controls.regime_permutation: deterministic cyclic permutation of event directions within symbol; full-model gross expectancy must be strictly greater at every horizon
p4_controls.ablation_pass_rule: full-model gross expectancy must be strictly greater than each ablation at every frozen horizon

parameter_provenance_additions_required_.name: development_horizon_vector_hours
parameter_provenance_additions_required_.reason: Frozen neighborhood spanning the candidate's multi-hour-to-day native horizon; all horizons must pass so there is no best-horizon selection.

parameter_provenance_additions_required_.name: development_min_completed_events
parameter_provenance_additions_required_.reason: Bounded early-feasibility floor to prevent one/few-event Alpha Proof while keeping development screening materially faster than prospective survivor validation.

next_if_pass: Complete P5 adversarial review lineage, rerun exact Alpha Proof V2, and only after P0-P6 PASS freeze a fresh prospective boundary.
next_if_fail: Seal economic/control failure and route the active alpha slot to the next non-redundant Alpha-Proof-ready candidate; no rescue threshold/horizon tuning.
